item.title: Air Force reports first U.S. space-based weapon deployment
item.description: The U.S. has deployed its first space-based weapon, according to the Air Force. Washington Post national security correspondent Tara Copp reports.

item.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles announces she is cancer-free
